items.question: What specific object or mark situated at the forehead must be offered or recognized when acting in the presence of the god-worshipped one after completing the prescribed act?
premises: A mark situated in the forehead-syllable mass is to be identified here.
A hundred-thousand measure is linked to that mark in this context.
The act is completed prior to directing attention to the god-worshipped recipient.
items.inference: After completing the prescribed act, one directs attention to the hundred-thousand mark situated in the forehead-syllable mass in relation to the god-worshipped one.
uncertainties: The exact ritual function of the hundred-thousand mark remains unclear from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Having done the act, one turns to the hundred-thousand mark situated in the mass of forehead syllables, O god-worshipped one.
